recognize_zh: CD61 免疫染色中，五顆強陽性巨核細胞排成一列聚集，其中數顆含兩個以上分離的小圓核或核呈低分葉，另見散在陽性小型細胞與血小板，突顯巨核細胞聚集及發育不良。
features: CD61 IHC with strong granular cytoplasmic staining of megakaryocytes
Loose cluster of five megakaryocytes aligned together
Several megakaryocytes with two or more separated small round nuclei or hypolobated nuclei
Scattered small positive cells and platelet fragments in the interstitium
Negative background myeloid and erythroid cells; adipocytes at right
describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemical stain on the bone marrow core biopsy highlights a loose cluster of megakaryocytes, several of which contain two or more widely separated small round nuclei or hypolobated nuclei. Additional small CD61-positive cells and platelet fragments are scattered in the interstitium, raising the possibility of micromegakaryocytes. The remaining hematopoietic cells are negative. Findings support megakaryocytic dysplasia with clustering in a myeloid neoplasm associated with germline GATA2 mutation.

ddx.vs: MPN clusters contain large hyperlobated or cloud-like megakaryocytes rather than small multinucleated forms with separate nuclei.
Reactive megakaryocytes are dispersed and have normally lobulated nuclei.
AMKL shows sheets of small CD61-positive blasts rather than scattered maturing megakaryocytes.
